messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the obs-rfc — we need a concrete plan for attributing inference cost when prefix-cache hits happen. current billing ties to final model call only
alex: yeah this is causing noise. If a request hits the prefix cache, the backend inference token count is 0 but the cache still cost us GPU memory + maintenance. need a way to record that
jamal: agreed. proposal: emit a lightweight span at cache lookup with attr `cache.hit=true` and `cost_hint=cache_size_bytes` so cost pipeline can pick it up
sophie: short question — do we want cost attribution to be per-span or per-request? per-span lets us split costs across components but complicates query surface
lee: leaning per-request but with sub-allocations. we already stitch traces to requests downstream, so pipeline can sum span-level costs then reconcile to request-level billing bucket
maria: okay, two sub-proposals: (A) span-level cost hints (fast, coarse: bytes, mem-ms, estimated GPU-use) + aggregator that rolls to request; (B) tag at request boundary with `inference.cost_split=[cache:xx, model:yy]` produced after enrichment job
alex: (A) is simpler for streaming requests and for partial responses. (B) gives prettier single-attr for billing but needs late enrichment and can break SLO reporting timelines
jamal: also important: sampling. we can't emit full cost metadata on every traffic path — sampling must preserve unbiased estimates for cost. suggest reservoir sampling keyed by model+route
sophie: +1. also add deterministic sampling for debug mode (user opt-in) so we can surface exact billing on demand
lee: on the schema side, let's avoid new ad-hoc keys for every component. propose `rw.cost.items` as an array of objects with fields: `kind`, `units`, `value_est`, `origin_span_id`. we can keep it small and parsable
maria: example snippet for trace-enricher to emit (for implementers):
```
rw.cost.items: [ {"kind":"cache_hit","units":"mem_bytes","value_est":"12345","origin":"span-abc"}, {"kind":"inference","units":"tokens","value_est":"56","origin":"span-def"} ]
```
lee: love it. but arrays in trace tags are annoying in some backends. maybe use compact CSV `rw.cost=cache:bytes:12345;inference:tokens:56` as fallback
alex: agree — primary structured attr + compact fallback string. enrichers should prefer structured when supported
jamal: also: need coverage in observability pipeline to attach cost items to billing keys before sampling drops events. so sampling must be informed by billing-key entropy
sophie: +1. we should also define a policy for evicting origin_span_id when PII concerns arise (strip after 7d by default)
maria: ops-bot can we get a quick check on retention defaults?
ops-bot: retention-check: default trace attr retention = 30d, sensitive attr purge = 7d. will open infra ticket to offer per-team overrides
maria: thanks. next steps: 1) write short RFC PR with (A) span-level cost hints + compact string fallback, (B) deterministic/ reservoir sampling guidelines, (C) enrichment job sketch to roll costs to request buckets. 2) ops to add retention override opt-in. 3) schedule 30m sync with infra+billing next week
alex: i'll draft the PR, pinging @jamal for sampling text
jamal: ping received — i'll add sampling math and example queries
sophie: i'll add a couple of example dashboards to show how to slice cache vs model cost
lee: tagging the internal RFC as `obs-cost-cache-split` will help find it later
maria: awesome. if no objections i'll create the PR later today. :thumbsup:
